Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The desktop has keyboard and accessibility tests, but the inspected evidence does not establish the specific non-macOS menu-bar activation contract: showing the menu bar and reaching it with F10/Alt. Existing keymap coverage is not a substitute for that platform route. Implement platform-aware menu activation and add a focused FX journey that reaches commands through F10/Alt without relying on macOS behavior.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/test/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/journey/KeyboardJourneySuite.scala:104
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/keys/CommandRegistry.scala:162

Remaining / next action: Implement and test F10/Alt menu-bar activation on the supported non-macOS route.

Disposition: Keep open.
